description: Read one person's Action Center items from OpenVibe.Actor (plan 2026-10-28 §3.10): agent tasks (running, needing the person, done or failed), pending approvals, and personal agents' next scheduled runs, as common.action-list-result@1. GET /api/v1/actions?subject=usr_… with a service token; granted to OpenVibe.Network's aggregator only. Never another person's items, and only the fields of common.action-item@1.
